<!-- title: v2.0.7 – Release workflow and one-step versioning -->
**Maintenance release: the release asset is now built by a GitHub Actions workflow from a checked tag, and the version is set by one script. The toolkit scripts behave exactly as in 2.0.6.**

> The end-to-end lab validation of the 2.x scripts (L1-L20) is in progress ([docs/VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.7/docs/VALIDATION.md)). Validate in your own lab first.

## What changes for you

Nothing in the behaviour of the toolkit: the scripts in `scripts\` differ from 2.0.6 only in their version line.

How a release is made is new ([docs/RELEASING.md](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.7/docs/RELEASING.md)):

- **Built by GitHub Actions from the tag.** The release workflow checks the tag before it builds: annotated, on `main`, version, CHANGELOG, release notes, signature against `.github/allowed_signers`. It then builds the asset and creates a draft release. The maintainer reviews the draft and publishes it. The job summary of the run shows every check.
- **Contents digest.** `tools/Build-SoaRelease.ps1` prints the SHA-256 of `SHA256SUMS.txt`. An independent build of the same tag has the same contents digest, even if the zip digest differs.
- **One script sets the version.** `tools/Set-SoaVersion.ps1` sets it in every place and refuses a version that exists already. Changes collect under `## Unreleased` in the CHANGELOG until the release.
- **The PDF** shows the current version again (the PDF in 2.0.6 still said 2.0.5).

## Upgrade from 2.0.6

1. Replace the toolkit files and keep your `SoaToolkit.config.psd1`; there are no new keys.
2. Optional: `.\Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step DeployTasks` puts the scripts with the new version line on the hosts. Nothing else is needed.

Details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.7/CHANGELOG.md)

## Verify the download

Compare the SHA-256 of the asset with the digest GitHub shows next to it. The zip contains `SHA256SUMS.txt` for every file:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\cloudsync-soa-toolkit-2.0.7.zip -Algorithm SHA256
Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Unblock-File
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/compare/v2.0.6...v2.0.7
